configuration.crypto: Separate same LCG seeded with seed XOR 0x9e3779b9; randomUUID and getRandomValues controlled
configuration.order: DraftScreen: ascending wins for every round; first round uses resolveFirstRound
configuration.reports: ensureDraftEvaluation; ordinary private CPU uncertainty 18; no human scouting or refinement
configuration.refusals: No human club: CPU picks do not invoke draftRefused, matching production CPU behavior
configuration.acquisition: Only after all rounds, through applyDraftAcquisitions; confirmed first picks use _drafted/_r1winner
configuration.actualCoreMean: Unweighted velocity/control/breaking for pitchers; contact/power/eye for batters. Not the role-weighted observed current.
configuration.abilityHistograms: 10-point bins; no asserted quality, concentration, role or age balance thresholds

limitations: Twenty independent game-start rosters plus generated classes, not twenty played seasons or a longitudinal balance result.
One draft year; no contract, retirement, growth, season simulation, UI, save/load or player outcomes in this measurement.
Starting roster composition and existing six-round rules determine available slots. CPU registration skips remain intact.
Missing important positions use production organizationNeeds primary-role minima; secondary positions and ability readiness are unassessed.
Acquisitions enter the farm. Active operating shortages can remain although projected organization depth improves.
Refusal/exhausted-pool/legacy-report edge cases are covered separately by existing regressions and browser/offseason QA.
